brief.summary: Eight inflections were detected across x402 payment series. In the week of 2026-08-24, Coinbase, Dexter and Base transactions fell roughly 80% while the Figment facilitator jumped about 303x. In the week of 2026-09-14, Figment reversed (-98%), PayAI fell about 99%, and Solana and total x402 transactions dropped sharply. None of the provided HN stories plausibly explain these shifts, and the pattern (volume moving between facilitators, then collapsing) suggests a measurement or traffic-attribution artifact, so a human should review before anyone draws business conclusions.

inflections.headline: Coinbase facilitator weekly median txs fall ~79%; no evidence explains it

claims.text: Coinbase facilitator weekly median transactions fell from 2304730.0 to 480568.5 (ratio 0.209).
An HN launch about AI agents paying for data via x402 is among the evidence documents, but nothing in it explains the drop. The cause is unknown.
claims.quote: Show HN: I built an M2M payment loop where AI Agents pay for data via x402

inflections.headline: Dexter facilitator weekly median txs fall ~81%; unexplained

claims.text: Dexter facilitator weekly median transactions fell from 26664.0 to 5177.5 (ratio 0.194).
The drop coincides in timing with the Coinbase and Base declines and the Figment surge, but no provided document explains it.

inflections.headline: Figment facilitator jumps ~303x from a tiny base; unexplained

claims.text: Figment facilitator weekly median transactions rose from 4862.0 to 1473925.0 (ratio 303.152).
The jump coincides in timing with declines at Coinbase and Dexter, which may indicate volume reattribution between facilitators, but this is a hypothesis and no source confirms it.

inflections.headline: x402 on Base weekly median txs fall ~78%; unexplained

claims.text: x402 Base weekly median transactions fell from 2412757.0 to 522340.5 (ratio 0.216).
Nearby HN launches such as Orthogonal are agent-payment products, but no source links them to Base volume.
claims.quote: Show HN: Orthogonal – One integration for agents to discover and pay for APIs

inflections.headline: Figment facilitator collapses ~98% after its August surge; unexplained

claims.text: The Figment facilitator's weekly median transactions after the week of 2026-09-14 were a ratio of 0.019 of the prior median.
The HN stories in the window (e.g. Skillsync, Foremerge) concern coding-agent tooling and are not about x402 facilitators; they do not explain the drop.
claims.quote: Launch HN: Skillsync (YC W26) – AI chat sessions made portable across agents

inflections.headline: PayAI facilitator weekly median txs fall ~99%; unexplained

claims.text: PayAI facilitator weekly median transactions fell from 4485090.0 to 49368.5 (ratio 0.011).
No provided document references PayAI or explains the drop.

inflections.headline: Total x402 weekly median txs fall ~90%; unexplained

claims.text: Total x402 weekly median transactions fell from 7708357.5 to 759455.0 (ratio 0.099).
The drop coincides in timing with the PayAI and Solana declines, but no provided source explains it.

claims.text: x402 Solana weekly median transactions fell from 5324299.5 to 130906.0 (ratio 0.025).
The Solana decline coincides in timing with the PayAI decline, but no provided source links them or explains either.

watchlist: facilitator_figment-facilitator_txs: surged then collapsed within three weeks; check whether the volume is real usage or spam/test traffic.
facilitator_payAI_txs and x402_solana_txs: both fell 97%+ in the week of 2026-09-14; check for data-pipeline or indexing changes and whether volume recovers.
x402_all_txs: down ~90%; confirm whether the new baseline holds or the earlier level was inflated by a few high-volume facilitators.
facilitator_coinbase_txs, facilitator_dexter_txs and x402_base_txs: re-check whether the late-August decline persists.
